summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests nab-paclitaxel given as pressurized intraperitoneal aerosolized chemotherapy (PIPAC), together with paclitaxel and ramucirumab, in stomach cancer that has spread to the peritoneum. Nab-paclitaxel is given into the abdomen over 40 minutes on day 1 of each 8-week cycle, paclitaxel and ramucirumab are given by vein on set days, and cycles repeat for up to 3 cycles before the schedule changes to 28-day cycles. The study looks at safety, side effects, and the best dose.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 prueba nab-paclitaxel administrado como quimioterapia intraperitoneal presurizada en aerosol (PIPAC), junto con paclitaxel y ramucirumab, en el cáncer de estómago que se ha extendido al peritoneo. El nab-paclitaxel se administra en el abdomen durante 40 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 8 semanas, mientras que el paclitaxel y el ramucirumab se administran por vena en días indicados, y los ciclos se repiten hasta 3 veces antes de cambiar a ciclos de 28 días. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis.
who_for: Gastric adenocarcinoma with visible peritoneal metastatic disease
Got worse on first-line therapy with a fluoropyrimidine and platinum-based treatment
Blood counts, liver, kidney and clotting tests within set limits
not_for: Intolerance to taxanes or allergy to similar compounds
Any history of brain or subdural metastases
Bowel obstruction needing total parenteral nutrition
History of heart attack or stroke
